answer: Mahaveer Educational & Charitable Trust (MECT) is a registered non-profit organization in Odisha dedicated to advancing higher education access across all 30 districts. MECT’s core mission is advancing higher education access across all 30 districts of Odisha through tuition grants and mentorship.

q: How can I mentor students in Odisha?

MECT currently has three planned scholarship schemes:

*   **Mahaveer Shiksha Protsahan Yojana [Planned]**: Tuition fee grants for undergraduate and technical students in Odisha.
*   **Pratibha Excellence Fellowship [Draft Proposal]**: Support for postgraduate studies and competitive exam preparation (UPSC/OPSC/GATE).
*   **Project Samarth [Draft Proposal]**: Community study centers and reference libraries, piloting in Khordha District.

Official intake dates and detailed eligibility criteria will be announced on https://mect.org.in/.

*   Odisha residency.
*   Minimum 60% marks in 10th, 12th, or Diploma.
*   Annual family income under ₹2,50,000 (verified by Revenue Authority).
*   Enrollment in a recognized college or university.
